title: Sentinel Re-Entry Vehicle Facility (RSRV) Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) Project
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SPD > W075 ENDIST LOS ANGELES
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Los Angeles District (SPL) is issuing a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for an FY27 Construction Management At Risk (CMAR) Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) for military construction to qualified and interested CMAR Teams to participate in the delivery of the Sentinel Re-Entry Vehicle Facility (RSRV) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) in Santa Barbara County, California. CMAR Teams may submit a White Paper as the first step in a competitive, two-step selection process. The CMAR team will be selected based on proven past performance, credentials of key personnel, and collaborative capabilities rather than a price proposal. The selected CMAR Teams will facilitate early, open-book collaboration with the Government, its design Architect-Engineer of Record (A-E DOR), and Air Force stakeholders to reconcile design packages, optimize constructability, and validate weapon system requirements. The Government will evaluate White Papers based on the criteria identified in this announcement using a qualifications-based, collaborative evaluation process. The evaluation is intended to identify the CMAR Team best suited to partner with the Government to further develop the project scope, technical solution, and agreement terms during subsequent phases of the process. The Department of the Air Force and Air Force Global Strike Command require the construction of a new Sentinel Re-Entry Vehicle Facility (RSRV) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) to support critical Ground Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD) developmental and operational testing while preserving the active Minuteman III test launch schedule. This project will deliver a highly complex, explosive-sited vertical defense facility featuring a primary 1,152 SM payload handling building equipped with specialized heavy crane and mechanical systems, secure spaces built to Intelligence Community Directive 705 (ICD-705) standards, a 743 SM shop/surveillance area, and a 427 SM munitions maintenance administration space to support a 22-person missile maintenance crew. The NAICS code for this procurement is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The procurement instrument is Other Transaction (OT) Agreement utilizing Construction Management at Risk (CMAR). Phase 1 will be for pre-construction services. Phase 2 may be added by modification for construction upon successful negotiation of a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) subject to authorization, approvals, and availability of funds. The estimated program amount of this acquisition is $110,000,000.00. The RFQ is available through the Solicitation Module of the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) suite at https://piee.eb.mil/. For instructions on how to post White Papers, please refer to the Posting Offer demo: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/sol/Posting_Offer.pdf. Additional information is available via Web Based Training for the Solicitation Module at: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/xhtml/wbt/sol/solicitation/proposals.xhtml.
